quotes.quoteText: Chronic lack of competitiveness in Arkansas' election process — election reforms to add diversity and competition of ideas.
quotes.kellyResponseFrame: Competition of ideas yes — clerks need implementation support and published rules every Monday.
quotes.doNotMisquote: Do not attribute ranked-choice specifics unless sourced on campaign site at time of use.

quotes.quoteText: Use skills as economist, data analyst, and communicator to provide greater fiscal transparency to the Secretary of State's office and state government finances.
quotes.kellyResponseFrame: Transparency yes — SOS must also publish county election funding ledgers and clerk training calendars, not only fiscal dashboards.
quotes.doNotMisquote: Treasurer race framing — verify SOS-specific adaptation on pakko4ar.com before stage.

quotes.quoteText: Established political class protect privileged positions — front-row seat observing lack of competitiveness.
quotes.kellyResponseFrame: Agree voters deserve choices — contrast daily SOS administration vs commentary.
quotes.doNotMisquote: Do not say Pakko attacks Kelly personally — frame is systemic duopoly.

quotes.quoteText: Libertarian Party qualified as new political party for 2026 — candidates nominated by convention.
quotes.kellyResponseFrame: Lawful ballot access matters — SOS must administer fairly for all qualified candidates.
